article.title: Resistance to Japan’s growing ‘war posture’ against China: The Sixteenth Asia Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Editor
article.content: Missile units on southern islands, troops moving on civilian ferries, command bunkers dug underground: a grassroots movement across Japan is trying to halt the drift back towards imperial confrontation. Remembering the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
